goal: Formalization of the weakly convex lower bound manuscript, including its literal logarithmic dimension reduction.

items.title: Informal
items.notes: The exact main theorem implies the informal asymptotic statement, using the actual prescribed-radius WCLB hard family.

items.title: Function class
items.notes: GapBound is proved equivalent to the bounded-below infimum formulation.

items.title: $\epsilon$-stationary point
items.notes: Uses the actual infimum Moreau envelope and mathlib gradient, with actual proximal minimizers.

items.title: {First-order oracle}
items.notes: The entire Frechet subdifferential is compact, convex, nonempty and Hausdorff-Borel. No chosen-subgradient replacement is used.

items.title: Randomized first-order algorithm
items.notes: Total-real Borel seed rules are equivalent to the paper unit-interval rules by a proved continuous clamp extension.

items.title: Oracle complexity
items.notes: Infimum over algorithms, supremum over instances, then earliest successful integer time; empty success set gives infinity. Arbitrary subclasses are explicit.

items.title: Main randomized lower bound
items.notes: Proved with universal constants c0=1/512 and c=2^-29, independent of confidence. The final proof uses the actual WCLB fixed-radius family; the shared WC analytic/scaling proof is reused. The logarithmic-dimension statement is also proved separately.

items.title: Unscaled hard instance properties
items.notes: All C1-C4 fields are filled with actual proofs. Natural index r represents paper time t=r-1, including t=-1.

items.title: Tilted-block locality
items.notes: Exact support of every actual Frechet subgradient in the first n+1 coordinates.

items.title: Variational representation
items.notes: The inner maximum is attained over the actual nonnegative Euclidean unit ball, with the exact relay representation.

items.title: Progress regularity
items.notes: Actual clipped-cubic derivatives, endpoint derivatives, gradient bounds and monotonicity are proved.

items.title: Weak convexity of the coupled function
items.notes: Actual modulus 9/2 of the coupled function, derived from the exact variational maximum.

items.title: Majorant regularity
items.notes: Finiteness, boundedness below, 2-Lipschitz regularity, weak convexity and coordinate antitonicity are proved.

items.title: Width of the diagonal filtration
items.notes: Literal direct sum, quotient dimension equality and width at most five, including the initial layer.

items.title: Complete raw subdifferential
items.notes: The literal union over active weights and blockwise formula, including compactness, convexity and coefficient bounds.

items.title: Sources and complete majorant subdifferential
items.notes: Actual maximizing points are nonempty and compact; the full subdifferential is their actual source-slope convex hull. The explicit radius bound is stronger than local boundedness.

items.title: Source order and remote singleton
items.notes: Every maximizing source lies below the query coordinatewise; every remote source has the exact singleton subdifferential.

items.title: Robust complete-oracle identity
items.notes: Exact function value, full subdifferential basepoint identity and support containment, for every actual source and every full subgradient.

items.title: Terminal-layer stationarity
items.notes: The explicit terminal-stationarity conjunction proves the horizon bound, the literal subspace case and the robust hidden-coordinate case. The reverse coordinateSpan-to-zero-outside bridge is proved, not left as an informal inference.

items.title: Initial gap
items.notes: The new literal 5M/N bound follows from the already proved exact minimum and exact initial-gap identity.

items.title: Properties of the radial modification
items.notes: Uses exactly R=2^18(M+sqrt(MN)) and the paper normalized max formula. The actual own-envelope barrier and complete exterior oracle are proved; this is not an undocumented reuse of the older enlarged radius.

items.title: Randomized reduction
items.notes: The exact logarithmic threshold is proved with a closed-event exponential spherical cap bound, genuine stabilizer averaging, all-query and arbitrary-output oracle coupling, and the actual Haar-frame/private-seed product probability. No conditional law or tail estimate is assumed.

representation_notes: The WCLB construction is exactly the existing coupled function and least 2-Lipschitz majorant, with zero-based coordinates.
The final main proof uses WCLB.uniformFamilies and the actual prescribed WCLB radius R=2^18(M+sqrt(MN)). The shared WC scaling and analytic library are reused.
The exact logarithmic dimension bound is independently proved by WCLB.randomized_reduction on the actual Haar-frame/private-seed product measure. No polynomial dimension bound is substituted.
